semantics: One line s, 1<=|s|<=10^5 (public statement 10<sup>5</sup>; row text flattened to 105), over . , ; digits and Latin letters. Words are maximal runs without , or ; so k separators give k+1 words, empty words included. A word is a number iff it is "0" or a nonzero digit followed by digits (no sign, dot or leading zero). Output line1: numbers joined by "," in order, quoted, or - if none; line2: all other words likewise. Unique output; lines contain no whitespace so token comparison equals line comparison. Checked against a character-level state machine and exhaustive small strings.
